title: policy.json: judgement
description: Starting weights for recorded judgements (design part 3.2, Judgement). Calibration moves them with the record (the milestone Trust calibration).

weights.description: Prior weight, from 0 to 1, per person ("owner" or a contributor ID) and basis. "default" applies to anyone not listed. The owner's gut checks start high: the owner's experience is real evidence.

lift.description: How far a judgement's weight raises the confidence and value of what it judges: confidence moves that share of the way to 1, scaled by the weight, and value is multiplied by 1 plus weight times lift. 0 turns the prior off. A judgement that evidence contradicts is held out until the person it came from answers.
